queries.query: Momentum Factor Effect in Country Equity Indexes (Quantpedia, WebFetch primary source re-verification)

sources.claim: Quantpedia's 'Momentum Factor Effect in Country Equity Indexes' (source paper Muller & Ward 2010, Studies in Economics and Econometrics 34(1)): rank ~70 MSCI World country equity indexes by 10-12 month momentum, hold the top 4-5 for one month, monthly rebalance. Reported backtest 1970-2009 (Muller & Ward's own sample): the 4-best-of-70 portfolio outperformed an equal-weighted benchmark by ~10%/yr; Quantpedia's own figure-13 readout at Quantpedia's chosen parameters: 17.7%/yr, max drawdown -65.39%, Sharpe not disclosed. Quantpedia's page cites a 2024 update (Du & Jiang) noting the efficacy of ETF momentum strategies 'while robust until around 2010, began to show signs of waning in subsequent years.'
sources.market_and_period: ~70 MSCI World country equity indexes, 1970-2009 (Muller & Ward's own sample; Quantpedia page itself dated 2026, cites a 2024 update note)
sources.applicability: Grounds the COUNTRY menu's mechanism (cross-sectional momentum across country equities); the menu itself (EWJ/EWG/EWU/EWA/EWC/EWZ/INDA/EWY/EWT) and grid parameters are this batch's own choice, reusing the already-live make_rotation_fn engine, not copied from this source's exact parameters.
sources.limitations: Practitioner summary, not the original 2010 journal paper; sample ends 2009, page itself discloses a 2024 update noting waning efficacy after ~2010; no long-only US-ETF or 2016-2026 figure disclosed.
sources.independent_replication: No independent third-party live/forward record of a long-only rotation across single-country US-listed ETFs found in this or a prior gap-search round.
